topic: How does the 11.6% bandwidth of the CTS antenna influence frequency planning and spectral efficiency for broadband satellite links?
response: The 11.6% bandwidth of the CTS antenna, as implied by its ability to achieve an axial ratio (AR) lower than 3 dB over a 52.9% relative bandwidth, may influence frequency planning and spectral efficiency for broadband satellite links. This is because a smaller bandwidth can lead to reduced interference and increased spectral efficiency, allowing for more efficient use of the available frequency spectrum.
